summary: Validated the new public shared Co-Parenting report viewer (/shared/coparenting/:token) end-to-end. Backend contract for share-link (token, path, viewer_path, excluded) and shared JSON/PDF endpoints work without auth. Frontend renders branded page correctly, hides excluded next_steps section, shows error card for invalid tokens, and does NOT surface the legal acknowledgment modal on /shared/* routes. Backend unit regression (test_cp_report + test_coparenting_scoring + test_sn_v3_scoring): 17 passed as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: coparenting_routes.py::shared_report default `format=pdf`: consider defaulting to json or explicitly enumerating format via Literal['json','pdf'] to avoid silent PDF response when caller forgets the param.

SharedCoParentingReport.jsx uses `fetch` directly with credentials:'omit' — good. However backend endpoint /report/shared/{token} is publicly cacheable; consider adding Cache-Control: private, no-store to avoid intermediary caching of a signed shared token URL.
seed_data_creation: Reset + bulk-answered 67 CP questions for parent1@test.com, completed, generated report, created share link with excluded=['next_steps']. Token persisted to /tmp/share_token.txt during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_cp_report.py tests/test_coparenting_scoring.py tests/test_sn_v3_scoring.py tests/test_shared_cp_viewer.py -q` = 20 passed. Shared viewer route confirmed: /shared/coparenting/:token exempted from LegalAcknowledgment modal via /shared/* prefix check.
verified_flows: GET /api/coparenting/report/shared/{token}?format=json (no auth) -> shared_by=Sam Parent, excluded_sections=['next_steps'], report.overall_rating set

Frontend /shared/coparenting/<token>: banner (Early Progress · Sam Parent · July 29, 2026), strengths, growth, sections, CTA rendered; next_steps hidden; legal modal NOT rendered; PDF button href points to backend PDF endpoint (fetched status 200 application/pdf); CTA primary -> '/', CTA signup -> '/signup'.
Frontend /shared/coparenting/INVALID_TOKEN: shows sharedcp-error card, no legal modal, no crash.
